display_long_description:
# Turn your room into a roller coaster.

Build tracks across your furniture, around your walls, and throughout your real-world space.  Then shrink down, jump into the front seat, and ride your creation in first person.

Build naturally with your hands or controllers, experiment with physics-powered gadgets, tackle 50+ challenges, and share your wildest creations with the community.
[media]
# BUILD IN YOUR ROOM

Turn your home into a coaster playground. Build tracks across furniture and throughout your space using intuitive hand tracking or controllers.

[media]
# JUMP IN AND RIDE

Shrink down to coaster-size and experience your creations from the front seat as your real room becomes a massive theme park.

[media]
# BUILD THE IMPOSSIBLE

Launch cars from cannons, blast through portals, attach rocket boosters, sculpt terrain, decorate your park, and experiment with physics.

[media]
# TAKE ON 50+ CHALLENGES

Master coaster building across Medieval, Western, Atlantis and Sci-Fi worlds while unlocking new cosmetics.


# SHARE YOUR CREATIONS

Upload your best coasters and discover rides built by other players.
